newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ford Q2, '97 estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ford Q2, '97 estimates raised.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Jack Kirnan said Thursday he raised his second quarter estimate for Ford Motor Co to $1.90 a share from $1.70 and his 1997 full-year estimate to $5.00 from $4.75.
-- Kirnan cited higher cost reduction targets being realized by the automaker and a smaller loss from its Latin American operations.
-- Kirnan said other analysts are likely to raise their estimates following an upbeat meeting Ford had with analysts earlier this week.
-- Kirnan said his target price for the stock remains $40. Ford was trading at 36-5/8, down 5/8.
